name: Napoleon Maiden: Moon, Night and Dreaming Rondo
storyline:
Shoichi Sakikawa is an ordinary second-year high school student. One day, on his way to school, he is nearly hit by a car but is saved by a girl wearing the uniform of his high school. The girl turns out to be a transfer student who has just joined Shoichi's class. Her name is Yuki Yashiro.

Meanwhile, a mysterious series of incidents has begun occurring in the town where Shoichi lives. People suddenly fall into a sleep from which they never awaken, eventually passing away as though lost in blissful dreams. This strange illness is known as "Dreambliss Syndrome."

Yuki Yashiro reveals that she possesses supernatural abilities and is known as a "Depositor." Through an unexpected turn of events, Shoichi finds himself investigating these mysterious incidents alongside Yuki.
summary: A supernatural mystery visual novel and the second episode in the Napoleon Maiden series. Blending modern school-life drama with urban fantasy and suspense, the story explores themes of fate and superhuman abilities as an unexplained sleeping phenomenon threatens a quiet town.
